name: booking-restrictions
description: Check why a Booking.com stay is unavailable, including minimum-stay settings and closed arrival or departure dates. Return the blocking fields and proposed settings changes. Use pasted inventory tables, restriction exports, B.XML requests or response bodies to explain why a stay cannot be sold or review a proposed fix. Separate minimum stay across occupied nights from minimum stay on arrival, check arrival and departure closures on their actual dates, and show room-level closure and shared-inventory effects. No account or installation is needed for pasted text or exports.
